old_caption: The video showcases a static arrangement of dominos on a wooden floor. The dominos are set in a radial pattern, with each color—red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, and black—forming a distinct spoke extending outward from a central point. A small yellow object sits at the center. The dominos begin to fall starting from the central point and propagate outward along each colored spoke. The wooden floor beneath provides a neutral background that contrasts with the vibrant colors of the dominos. The camera remains stationary, focusing on the entire circular formation.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases a dynamic sequence where a circular arrangement of dominos is set up on a wooden floor. The dominos are arranged in a radial pattern, with each color—red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, and black—forming a distinct spoke extending outward from a central point. A small red object, possibly a toy or a piece of equipment, sits at the center of the circle. As the video progresses, the dominos begin to fall in a synchronized manner, starting from the outer edges and moving inward towards the center. The sequence captures the dominoes toppling over one by one, creating a visually striking effect as they cascade down the spokes. The wooden floor beneath provides a neutral background that contrasts with the vibrant colors of the dominos, enhancing the visual impact of the falling sequence. The camera remains stationary throughout, focusing on the entire circular formation to ensure all the dominos' movements are captured clearly.
caption: The video showcases a complex star-shaped arrangement of dominoes set up on a light wooden floor. Eight colored arms, including yellow, green, blue, dark blue, purple, pink, red, and orange, radiate from a central point, connected by short black segments. A long line of black dominoes extends horizontally across the bottom foreground and connects vertically to the center. From the beginning until roughly twelve seconds, the entire structure remains completely static with no movement observed. Around thirteen seconds, the black connecting segments near the center begin to topple inward toward the middle. By fifteen seconds, the collapse reaches the base of the colored arms, where the innermost dominoes of the red, pink, purple, and dark blue arms fall first. Between sixteen and twenty seconds, the falling motion propagates outward along all eight colored arms simultaneously, creating a symmetrical collapsing pattern where the dominoes lie flat progressively away from the center.
